text:
Iron is extracted from hematite in the blast furnace at a temperature of about 1550°C.
Which equation shows the main reaction that increases the temperature in the furnace?
CaCO3→  CaO  +  CO2
A
C  +  O2→  CO2
B
CO2  +  C  →  2CO
C
Fe2O3  +  3CO  →  2Fe  +  3CO2
D
subject: Chemistry
